chunks: Muḥammad ibn Muslim asked Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام about the well.
in which a dead animal falls, and he said: “If it has an odor, twenty buckets should be drawn from it.”

key_terms.الْبِئْرِ: the well being asked about in the ruling
key_terms.الْمَيْتَةُ: a dead animal or carcass that falls into the well
key_terms.دَلْوًا: a bucket used to draw water from the well
key_terms.رِيحٌ: an odor indicating the effect of the carcass in the water
key_terms.نُزِحَ: water should be drawn out from the well

ai.seo_question: What should be done if a dead animal falls into a well and it has an odor?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding a well into which a dead animal has fallen. Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام states that if the carcass causes an odor, twenty buckets of water are to be drawn from the well.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.34 - Muhammad ibn Muslim asked Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) about a dead animal that falls into a well.
Imam (as) said: "If it has an odor, twenty buckets should be drawn from it."
